text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. Admin shrank, and customer prep got sharper.

2. CRM data improved. Notes were logged the same day, not three days later from memory.

3. Adoption wasn't automatic. Reps trusted it only after seeing summaries match what they remembered.

4. Customers cared about consent. A quick heads-up at the start of every meeting prevented awkward moments.

5. Managers finally saw real objections, not filtered recaps. Coaching got specific.

The tool didn't make anyone a better seller. It removed the friction that kept good sellers from doing the basics.

Would your team trust it in the room?

#SalesEnablement #AI #B2BSales
